more_info.overview: Glycyrrhizin, also called glycyrrhizic acid, is a sweet-tasting saponin associated with liquorice root. It is one of the compounds responsible for liquorice's characteristic taste. FDA separately specifies liquorice extracts and certain glycyrrhizin salt preparations for flavouring and flavour enhancement in particular foods. Those extract and salt specifications do not define every isolated glycyrrhizin preparation. This historical entry therefore needs to be distinguished from a whole liquorice-root ingredient.
